== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' (not an official image) of the Virtual Legacy card [[Rebel Agent (Errata)]] — version PC-E1 of •Rebel Agent (Virtual Block 8.1, later retitled [[Kyle Katarn|Kyle Katarn]]).

No published card image shows this text: the Virtual Block 8.1 release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-01-Kyle_Katarn.png]]) prints the original text ([[Rebel Agent]]), and the Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1281-28-front-master.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-kylekatarn-pre.gif]]) print the current card ([[Kyle Katarn]]).

Text source: Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064747/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive), the same text in every capture to 11 January 2013 (VBlock8Type and VMasterType); the card list writes the icon as “(Scoundrel)”, the icon here is the printed one.

PC-E1 text: “May use any stolen weapon. Opponent may not react to or from same site. Your total battle destiny +1 here, for each [Scoundrel] Effect on table. Once per game, may make a regular move during your control phase. Immune to attrition < 4 (< 5 if armed).” Title •Rebel Agent, lore “Scoundrel.” as on the release-sheet slip.

Made: 9 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (rev 73), from the card's own Virtual Legacy card (PC card image art). Not an official image.

* Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
